creator: Alexander Terp
description: From the duplicate-wake fix (24151394, 2026-10-21). One trial, in the shared app-server setup: a message queued 3 s after a turn was ended with Esc was still not taken 60 s later. If an idle Codex without the app-server - the setup on the Mac mini, where ~/.codex/config.toml sets daemon_auto_start = false - behaves the same, a wake to an agent just interrupted with Esc is typed after COMMAND_ANSWER (20 s), and Codex delivers its stored copy as a second wake at the next turn's end. Measure with the stub-model setup in corpus/codex-0.163.0/queue-latency.txt and a stub that holds one request open, so the turn can be interrupted.
title: Measure whether an idle Codex without the app-server takes a queued wake after an Esc
